content:
The BUILT CoLAB executive team has been holding a series of meetings with its Associates. These meetings aim to bring teams closer together, as well as identify needs or points of collaboration that could be developed between the entities.


So far the team has already had the opportunity to meet with companies and with academic entities. While with associated companies the focus has been on concrete needs in terms of digitalisation, with Academia the focus has been on identifying common ground in researching solutions for the digital and climate transition, without losing sight of the circularity of the built environment. In this way, through these meetings, BUILT CoLAB believes it can also contribute to transferring the knowledge developed in an academic context to the working context of companies in the AEC sector.


This dynamism is part of BUILT CoLAB's mission as an association, and is also in line with the recommendations of ANI, FCT and its mentors.


These initiatives will continue over the coming months, for now in virtual format, due to health restrictions and according to the availability of the entities involved.
